description:
Batteries-included entry point for downstream studios (RFC 0040). The
        workspace stack (homing-workspace / -shell / -studio-workspace) is a
        strict downstream of homing-studio-base, so the "studio + workspace
        out of the box" wiring cannot live in studio-base itself (it would
        close a dependency cycle). This module sits ABOVE the whole stack and
        ties it together:

        - StudioStarterFixtures — a Fixtures that IS DefaultFixtures plus the
          Studio Workspace pre-wired: GenericWorkspace served, StudioWorkspaceSpec
          registered, and GET /catalogue-tree rooted at the studio forest.

        A downstream studio depends on THIS module only, constructs
        `new StudioStarterFixtures<>(umbrella)` instead of
        `new DefaultFixtures<>(umbrella)`, and the catalogue Navigator,
        tree feed, and leveled Open all light up with no per-studio wiring.

        Doctrinal anchor: A Good Design Doesn't Pick Up Its Substrate — the
        starter is the one place the application-assembly defaults are
        composed; nothing below it knows the workspace exists.
